meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标分解成有依据的执行步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把复杂目标拆成可执行的步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Break down goals into evidence-bound steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn complex goals into actionable steps.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的目标拆成细粒度步骤，按固定流程逐步执行；每步都要在真实界面（终端、浏览器等）留下证据，测试通过不算完成；代码改动交给子代理，并用 Git 原子提交。
howto.when: 当你说出 “ulw-loop”、“ulw” 等关键词，或要求做持久目标执行等工作时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 跑这个项目，先注册目标再逐步执行。
say.note: Claude 会先读取流程文档并注册目标。

say.text: ulw，把这个任务拆成原子步骤，每步都留证据。
say.note: 会按工作流拆解并逐步记录证据。

say.text: 做手动 QA 并记录证据，完成后 git 提交。
say.note: 会按证据规则执行 QA 并原子提交。

howto.what_en: Claude splits your goal into granular steps, executes a fixed loop, records evidence for each step (tests don't count), delegates code edits to subagents, and commits each verified unit atomically via Git.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-loop" or "ulw", or ask for durable goal execution, etc.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop: register the goal, then execute step by step.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow and registers the goal first.

say_en.text: ULW: decompose this task into atomic steps, with evidence at each step.
say_en.note: It follows the workflow and logs evidence as it goes.

say_en.text: Do manual QA with evidence, then git commit when done.
say_en.note: Runs QA per evidence rules and commits atomically.
